question.text: Let the lines <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><msub><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><msub><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> intersect at right angles at <math><mi>P</mi></math> (where <math><msub><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> are parameters). solution.text:
Since the lines intersect at right angle,

therefore, the locus of the point of intersection of lines is a circle with end points of diameter as 5,2 & 3,-4
x-5x-3+y-2y+4=0
⇒x2+y2-8x+2y+7=0
Hence, g22+f22-7=16+1-7=10
